content: {"episode_id":"ep-05034","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The patient has recurrent transient neurological deficits consistent with a recent transient ischemic attack in the context of a known personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction. Concurrent nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency raises clinical concern for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias contributing to embolic risk. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered to evaluate for occult arrhythmias that may be precipitating these ischemic events. We appeal the CO-197 denial for missing prior authorization and request reconsideration based on this documented clinical indication."}
